An Act 
Making technical corrections to the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act of 1968 and the 
Hazardous Liquid Pipeline Safety Act of 1979, and for other purposes.

through VII of this Act may be cited as the "Rail Safety and Service 
Improvement Act of 1982".

striking "once every 6 months." and substituting "twice each calen­
dar year.".

1968 (49 U.S.C. 1675(a)) is amended by striking "sixtieth day" and 
substituting "90th day".
